svg.text: SIMPLE EXAMPLE (N=2 Hops, D=7 Stages, W=8 Frontier States): Exact Matrix Projection Trace for True Faults s_2=0, s_5=0 (k* = 2)
Latent State Vector s ∈ {0,1}⁷ & Causal Censoring Frontier κ*(s) = 2 (Fault at s₅=0 is Masked by s₂=0):
Uniform over [L₀, R₀] = [0..7], Width W₀ = 8, Entropy H(b₀) = log₂(8) = 3.000 bits
▶ Execute Prefix Probe Π₃ (test stages 0..3): Since k*=2 ≤ 3, probe returns y₃ = 1 (FAIL)!
Step t=1 (Posterior b₁ after Π₃ = FAIL)
Project via P_[0,3] = diag(1,1,1,1,0,0,0,0): Support [L₁, R₁] = [0..3], Width W₁ = 4, H(b₁) = 2.000 bits (ΔI = 1.0 bit)
▶ Execute Prefix Probe Π₁ (test stages 0..1): Since k*=2 > 1, stages 0..1 are healthy → returns y₁ = 0 (PASS)!
Step t=2 (Posterior b₂ after Π₁ = PASS)
Project via P_[2,3] = diag(0,0,1,1,0,0,0,0): Support [L₂, R₂] = [2..3], Width W₂ = 2, H(b₂) = 1.000 bit (ΔI = 1.0 bit)
▶ Execute Prefix Probe Π₂ (test stages 0..2): Since k*=2 ≤ 2, probe returns y₂ = 1 (FAIL)!
Step t=3 (Exact Collapse b₃ = u₂ → Surgical Ontic Repair & Monotonic Advance to [3..7])
Project via P_[2,2] = u₂ u₂ᵀ: Support L₃ = R₃ = 2, Width W₃ = 1, Entropy H(b₃) = 0.000 bits! Exact Fault k*=2 Identified!
b₃ = (0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)ᵀ = u₂ ⟹ Repair do(s₂ ← 1), update L_new ← 3, bisect [3..6]
▶ Phase 2 Summary: From L=3, probe Π₆ (FAIL) → bisect [3..6] via Π₄ (PASS) → Π₅ (FAIL) → localizes k₂*=5 in 3 more probes!
